title.narrative: Bangladesh Agroecology Platform - Land & indigenous rights and biodiversity protection subgroup

description.narrative:
The Land & indigenous rights and biodiversity protection group is one of 3 subgroups of the Bangladesh Agroecology Platform (BAP). BAP was formed to bring together likeminded organisations, working on similar issues related to agroecology and the environment to advocate for change and to improve the lives of the poorest and most marginalised. The members are Bangladesh Krishok Federation (chair of this subgroup), Caritas Bangladesh, Ubinig, Bangladesh Association for Sustainable Development and Bangladesh Environmental Lawyers Association. The other two subgroups will work on (i) Seed and Seed Sovereignty; and (ii) Promotion of Agroecology Principles.
The Land & indigenous rights and biodiversity protection group has agreed five joint actions which include national conferences on (i) land and agrarian reform (focusing on Khasland); (ii) indigenous people's land and rights (iii) land and food sovereignty and (iv) land and agroecology. They also plan a demonstration on land and climate change in Dhaka. BKF will lead on the joint actions. The platform members will also conduct individual pieces of research on themes of particular interest to them. Other activities will include organising training sessions for other group members on their areas of specialisation (for example BKF on land and climate issues); exchange visits around specific events; and a seminar on issues around land, the environment and indigenous rights. Legal aid services will also be provided to farmers affected by land rights issues.
